title: Beale AFB EOD Airmen Demonstrate Equipment
description: U.S. Air Force explosive ordnance disposal Airmen assigned to the 9th Civil Engineer Squadron demonstrate EOD equipment and procedures at Beale Air Force Base, California, Sept. 1, 2026. The demonstration provided an overview of the capabilities and equipment the Airmen use during missions. (U.S. Air Force video by Airman 1st Class Ty’Jaih Wallace)
credit: U.S. Air Force video by Airman 1st Class Ty’Jaih Wallace
pass_reason: equipment demo with robots and suits, no detonation
